description: Pre-registered in experiments/msm_stage_gemma/spec.md (roadmap R3a). Three MSM placements vs matched controls on google/gemma-4-12B(+-it), both chloeli values, MSM-only (E) and +AFT (A) tiers; headline = OOD-gap on held-out-domain forced-choice evals, judge-free. Phase-0 gates before any full run: gemma-4 stack check (transformers/vLLM/Unsloth train->merge->serve), delta_apply tensor compat, Gemma template + assistant-only masking plumb, Gemma token accounting, ~$10 base-rate pilot (ceiling go/no-go), metric prerequisites (PLAN P1-5/7/9), leakage scan, smoke. Budget: seed 0 both values ~52 H100-h ~= $250-300 all-in; dev ~3-4 days. Decisions baked in (2026-07-06): combination = 1a released-delta transplant (1b out of scope); arms 1a/2 vs 3/4 instruct-scale confound accepted with caveat; seed 0 signs-of-life first.
title: msm_stage_gemma: MSM stage x combination on Gemma-4-12B (spec + phase 0 + seed-0 run)
